metadata.description: Acta and its companion skills: record a meeting, then process the recording locally

plugins.name: acta-notes
plugins.description: End-to-end processing of an Acta meeting recording in ~/Acta: local Parakeet transcription and offline VBx diarization via fluidaudiocli, utterance-level merge into a verbatim transcript.raw.md, anchor-based speaker naming that never guesses a name, quality gates with a provenance block, then a summary.md enriched from screenshots, calendar, Jira, Slack and local project docs. An official Teams VTT short-circuits the whole ASR path. Audio never leaves the machine (skills-only plugin, bundled Python stdlib scripts)
